summary: Frontend-only verification of the mobile Turkish+UAE flag pair visibility bug fix and header layout regressions. All primary and secondary checks PASS. Flags render (data-testid='brand-flag-pair', 2 flag SVGs) with display=flex and width>0 at 390/414/430/640/768/1024/1280/1536/1920 widths, and are correctly hidden (display=none) at the narrow 360px viewport as intended. No user-visible horizontal overflow at any breakpoint: at 768px document.scrollWidth exceeds innerWidth by 18px, but body/html overflow-x is non-scrollable in practice (window.scrollTo(100,0) yielded scrollX=0) — this is the pre-existing announcement-ticker marquee contained within its parent, not user-visible. Desktop alignment: flag block height 46px on lg+ with 80px logo (top:80, bottom:128), matching logo wordmark baselines. Navbar vs hero card widths at 1440/1536/1920: navSpan=1360, cardWidth=1104, leftExtra=128, rightExtra=128 (perfectly symmetric). Mobile menu at 390px opens, shows 'Vize Rehberi' group with items, closes via Escape. Homepage /, /vize-tipleri, /iletisim, /gelismeler load without page/console JS errors on mobile 390px (only Radix a11y warning about missing DialogTitle on the mobile sheet — accessibility improvement, not a bug).

issues: Radix DialogContent missing DialogTitle — screen-reader accessibility warning logged in console. Wrap title in VisuallyHidden or add a DialogTitle.

action_items: (Optional/A11y) Add DialogTitle (VisuallyHidden allowed) to the mobile menu Sheet/DialogContent to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Bug fix confirmed: brand-flag-pair uses min-[380px]:flex breakpoint — correctly shows on iPhone 14 (390) and hides on 360 as intended.
Nav row max-w-[88rem]=1408px produces symmetric ~128px overhang vs 1104px hero card at >=1440 widths — matches earlier design ask exactly.
768px marquee overflow (18px) is contained by parent overflow-hidden; no user impact but could be tightened.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Header measurements captured: at 390px flag block is 84x21 next to logo; at lg+ (>=1024) flag block is ~48x217 (h-[46px] w-[92px] per flag). Navbar container is max-w-[88rem]=1408px. Hero/summary card width 1104px. Symmetric 128px overhang confirmed at 1440/1536/1920. Mobile menu testid: mobile-menu-toggle. Apply button testid: navbar-apply-button. Flag testids: brand-flag-pair, tr-flag-icon, uae-flag-icon.
rca of the issue: Original bug (flags hidden on iPhone-sized viewport): main agent changed flag block visibility class to 'hidden ... min-[380px]:flex' so it appears at >=380px CSS width. Verified working at 390/414/430.
